set.body: PRD T-1..T-5. Opaque over Long microseconds; no floating-point time in the domain model. Instant has Order; Span has Order + CommutativeGroup. Interval STORES offset. Exactly one implementation of window filtering, taking an explicit Overlap policy. Document T-6 known limitations in Scaladoc.
set.title: Kernel time: Instant, Span, Hz, Interval, Overlap, ClockId, Sync
